rule: Rehearsal inputs only. Every entry is an engineering PROPOSAL or a MEASURE_PLACEHOLDER awaiting measurement; none is approved or a production value. The resolver refuses an entry for a value that is already approved.

mempool_max_txs_bytes.basis: The upstream default; set by the capacity tests (T05) on dedicated staging hosts.

mempool_size.basis: The upstream default; set by the capacity tests (T05) on dedicated staging hosts.

p2p_recv_rate.basis: The upstream default; set from measured block propagation on dedicated staging hosts (T02, T05).

p2p_send_rate.basis: The upstream default; set from measured block propagation on dedicated staging hosts (T02, T05).
